	add_to_variable = { global.rpx_world_total_states = num_owned_controlled_states }

		global.rpx_world_avg_factory_score = {
			value = global.rpx_world_total_factories

	log = "RPX STEP2 avg after math block: [?GLOBAL.rpx_world_avg_factory_score]"
	clamp_variable = {
		var = global.rpx_world_avg_factory_score
		min = 0.01
		max = 1000000
	}
	set_variable = { global.rpx_world_start_threat = threat }
	log = "RPX world context: factories=[?GLOBAL.rpx_world_total_factories] states=[?GLOBAL.rpx_world_total_states] avg=[?GLOBAL.rpx_world_avg_factory_score] threat=[?GLOBAL.rpx_world_start_threat]"
}
